serverInfo.name: Arsenal Decision Engine
serverInfo.description: Stateless R_net evaluation middleware for autonomous DeFAI agents. Computes Impermanent Loss, net yield, and Breakeven Corridor in O(1). Free tier: 100 calls per IP per day, custom parameters included; L402 Lightning micro-payment beyond it.

authentication.description: No authentication needed within the free quota: evaluate_pool allows 100 calls per IP per day, custom parameters included. Beyond that quota, an L402 Lightning micro-payment is required (currently 150 sats, set by server configuration). GET /mcp/audit/latest allows 3 free calls per IP per hour, then L402. Always read the authoritative amount from the WWW-Authenticate header or error.data.price_sats of the 402 response.

tools.name: evaluate_pool
tools.description: Evaluates a constant-product / full-range LP position risk. Computes R_net (net yield after IL), Breakeven Corridor bounds, and risk level (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL). O(1) algebraic — no LLM, no hallucination.

apy.description: Annualized Percentage Yield of the pool (e.g. 0.20 for 20%).

price_ratio.description: Current price / entry price ratio (e.g. 0.85 means price dropped 15%).

days_held.description: Number of days the position has been held.

r_net_pct.description: Net return after IL. Positive = profitable.

pricing.note: Current server configuration charges a flat 150 sats. Read the authoritative amount from the WWW-Authenticate header or error.data.price_sats of the 402 response rather than hard-coding it.
